This is a petition under Section 528 BNSS 2023 for quashing of FIR no. 491/2021, under Section 498A/323/406/506/34 IPC, PS Gandhi Nagar as also the proceedings emanating therefrom.
Notice is accepted by the Ld. APP appearing for the State who seeks time to filed Status report.
Notice be also sent to respondent no. 2 subject to petitioner taking requisite steps returnable for 16.04.2026.
